Template.Name: Cooling / reliability package
Template.Applicability: Resilience and temperature focus; exchanges deployment performance. Reliability uses the existing incident policy and is inactive without it. Available at every circuit.

PackageQuote.Timing: Resolves at preparation close; delay completes at the following preparation close without a second payment.
PackageQuote.OutcomeRange: Normal 0%; partial 100%; breakthrough 0%; compromised 0%; delay 0%. Normal: printed strengths/compromises; partial: half strength (minimum +1); breakthrough: +1 strength per attribute (cap +6); compromised: -1 strength (minimum +1) and Reliability -2, usually usable. Reliability affects only the existing incident policy and is inactive when that policy is disabled. Delay: normal specification available at the following preparation close, without repayment; beyond the calendar it stays pending. Quality transfers at most 10 percentage points from partial/compromised into normal; no extra hazard draw. All composed ratings remain 1–100.
